baseline_models.focus_anchor: جَنَّاتُ ... يَدْخُلُونَهَا ... يَدْخُلُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ كُلِّ بَابٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: A vegetation-concealed garden is entered, yet its shelter is not sealed: the doubled entry and totality of gates make controlled permeability part of the dwelling itself.

activation_trace.role: The garden as a place concealed by vegetation supplies the sheltered habitat.
Concealment and being hidden sharpen the habitat as protection rather than mere scenery.
Entry into an inside occurs twice and makes permeability an enacted relation.
Wholeness as complete encompassment distributes the second ingress across the entire threshold system.
A gate as the entrance of a thing supplies the controlled boundary crossed by the angels.

changed_reading.before: The gardens are a closed destination into which the rewarded are placed.
changed_reading.after: The gardens are protective yet deliberately permeable dwellings whose shelter is constituted by ordered entry from every gate.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ آبَائِهِمْ وَأَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ
baseline_models.mechanism: The three relation classes span formative ancestry, paired companionship, and dispersed continuation. Their admission is governed by becoming fitting, while reconciliation remains a live secondary force in the same focus root.

activation_trace.role: Suitability and fittingness supply the condition under which relations belong in the dwelling.
Reconciliation that removes estrangement keeps relational repair live beside individual righteousness.
Fatherhood as generation and upbringing supplies the household's formative line.
A counterpart joined to its pair supplies lateral household attachment.
Gentle dispersed emergence supplies descendants as a line spreading forward through time.

changed_reading.before: Each person receives an individual reward, with righteous relatives appended as companions.
changed_reading.after: Admission reconstitutes a cross-generational household of formative causes, joined counterparts, and dispersed continuations; fit and reconciled relation is part of the reward's shape.

baseline_models.mechanism: The subject shift across the repeated verb creates two nested arrivals: the household crosses into the garden, then angels cross into the household's occupied space. Arrival therefore continues after residence begins.

activation_trace.role: Repeated passage into an inside supplies the two-stage motion of residents and angels.
The interior and intimate inward space make the second entry an approach upon persons, not merely another building entrance.
The explicit angel branch fixes the second moving subject as angels.
Making a thing into multiple doors supplies a distributed network for the second arrival.

changed_reading.before: Entry is a single transfer into paradise followed by static residence.
changed_reading.after: Entry is recursive: humans enter the dwelling, then the dwelling opens into repeated angelic encounter from a distributed set of approaches.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence contrasts a firmly bound covenant and commanded joining with unbinding and severance, places the admitted family at its center, and follows it with peace. This revises familial ṣalaḥ from a merely private qualification toward relation kept, repaired, and made fit for the good home.

activation_trace.role: Reconciliation that removes estrangement gives the focus condition a relational mechanism.
Unbinding something firmly constructed supplies the rejected destruction of relation.
A confirmed covenant supplies the binding structure that must be preserved.
Joining one thing to another until it adheres supplies the positive action immediately preceding the family scene.
Peace as reconciliation against conflict supplies the household's voiced outcome.
Severing connection and instituting estrangement supplies the mirrored path to the bad home.

structural_cues: The 13:20-25 sequence runs bound covenant, commanded joining, admitted household, peace, then severed connection and bad home.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies binding, joining, the focus family list, peace, and mirrored severing; I infer that maintained or repaired relation is one arrow from ṣalaḥ to shared admission. A live alternative is that joining names general ethics while ṣalaḥ here denotes only each relative's individual righteousness.

changed_reading.before: Relatives enter only because each independently passes a moral threshold.
changed_reading.after: Independent righteousness remains live, but the household also enacts the commanded preservation and repair of bonds: reconciled relation belongs inside the good home's architecture.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pairs of fruit, neighboring gardens, same-origin palms, one irrigation, and measured wombs create a material analogy for the focus household: a shared source sustains differentiated relational branches, which are gathered without losing their distinct forms.

activation_trace.role: Each counterpart joined to a pair supplies differentiation by relation within created fruit.
Intertwining and vigorous plant growth make the garden a living assemblage rather than a neutral container.
Close siblings from one origin supply an explicit botanical image of differentiated kinship.
A share and channel of irrigation supplies one sustaining flow apportioned among distinct growths.
Womb-linked kinship connects biological emergence to the focus lineage list.
A measure by which a thing reaches its limit supplies bounded differentiation rather than undivided sameness.
Gentle dispersed emergence carries the ecological differentiation forward as descendants.

structural_cues: 13:3-4 places fruit pairs, neighboring gardens, same-origin palms, and one water before 13:8's measured wombs and 13:23's spouses and descendants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ecological and birth sequence; I infer an analogy between differentiated growth from shared provision and family branches regathered in the focus garden. A live alternative is that these are independent creation signs with no household-level arrow.

changed_reading.before: The family list is a social entourage added to an otherwise unrelated garden setting.
changed_reading.after: The family and garden can be read as one differentiated living assemblage: shared provision gathers paired and branching life without flattening its distinct relations.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier successive preservers occupy front and rear; in the focus, angels approach through every gate; immediately after, their approach becomes peace-address. The all-sided circuit shifts from vigilance around vulnerable persons to hospitable access around secured residents.

activation_trace.role: Succession and alternation supply a circulating sequence of preservers.
Guarding and attentive preservation supply the earlier protective function.
The explicit angels supply the agents of the later all-gate approach.
Entry into an inside converts an exterior perimeter into hospitable approach.
The gate as entrance supplies the boundary whose function has shifted from guarding to welcome.
Safety and freedom from harm supply the content of the angelic address.

structural_cues: 13:11 positions preservers before and behind, 13:23 distributes angelic entry across every gate, and 13:24 supplies their direct peace-address.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successive preservers, guarding, focus angels, all-gate entry, and peace; I infer continuity of protective function and its transformation into welcome. A live alternative is that the earlier preservers are unrelated to the focus angels and only provide a spatial analogy.

changed_reading.before: The angels are ceremonial visitors who arrive after the household is settled.
changed_reading.after: Their gate-by-gate approach completes an all-sided protective pattern: vigilance around vulnerable lives has become safe, intimate welcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later garden's flowing rivers, lasting yield, and lasting shade resolve an apparent tension in the focus: stable residence need not mean stasis. Shelter persists through ongoing flow, provision, and cover.

activation_trace.role: The vegetation-concealed garden repeats the focus habitat and links the later description back to it.
Flow and free coursing supply continuous motion within the stable shelter.
Continuance and permanence make recurring provision structurally stable.
Shade as covering shelter supplies the garden's enduring protection.
Intertwining, vigorous vegetation lets the focus garden carry living renewal rather than inert enclosure.

structural_cues: The un-inventoried focus modifier عَدْنٍ is retained only as a residence-frame; no branch identity is inferred for it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flow, enduring produce, enduring shade, and the focus garden; I infer stability-through-renewal as the arrow connecting them. A live alternative is a simple list of permanent amenities without a process model.

changed_reading.before: Permanent residence suggests an immobile, sealed endpoint.
changed_reading.after: Permanence is dynamically maintained: water courses, provision continues, vegetation renews, and shelter endures while entries remain active.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later pairing of messengers with spouses and descendants repeats two-thirds of the focus family list. The focus household can therefore preserve an embodied relational pattern carried through sacred history rather than suspend personhood in isolated reward.

activation_trace.role: Marriage partners assigned to messengers supply historical continuity for the focus spouses.
Gentle emergence and spread supply descendants as an ongoing historical line.
Generation and upbringing extend that embodied pattern backward into ancestry.

structural_cues: 13:38 explicitly assigns spouses and descendants to earlier messengers, repeating the focus vocabulary after the household admission scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated spouse-descendant pairing; I infer that the focus preserves an embodied, historical mode of personhood into the final dwelling. A live alternative is that 13:38 only rebuts an expectation about messengers and does not interpret 13:23.

changed_reading.before: Family accompaniment is an exceptional sentimental addition to essentially solitary salvation.
changed_reading.after: Shared admission preserves a durable embodied pattern already carried by messengers: personhood arrives with generational and marital relations rather than by erasing them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the crown-and-circumference branch beneath the ordinary quantifier كُلّ; it remains anchored in كُلِّ بَابٍ and the gate's frontier branch, but downstream prose should present it only as a spatial secondary image, not as a replacement translation.

activation_trace.role: A crown and what encircles supply a perimeter wrapped around the residents.
A terminal boundary or frontier distributes openings around that encircling edge.
Crossing into an inside turns the imagined circumference into an active ring of access.

changed_reading.before: Every gate simply means a large number of architectural doors.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the gates form a crowned perimeter: angelic approach saturates the household's whole boundary rather than using one privileged front.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a form-distant strength-and-cohesion branch under lexical مَلَائِكَة; it remains valid as a same-root material analogy anchored to the named angels and repeated ingress, but downstream prose must retain 'angels' and qualify cohesion as an exploratory functional resonance, not an etymological gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ يَدْخُلُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ كُلِّ بَابٍ

activation_trace.role: Strength and structural cohesion supply an exploratory function for the angelic arrivals.
The literal angel branch contains the activation and prevents replacement of the named agents.
Repeated ingress supplies the motion by which cohesion reaches the newly assembled household.
Each entrance supplies a threshold at which reinforcement enters.

changed_reading.before: The angels are only named visitors who deliver a greeting.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their repeated ingress also images cohesion arriving from every threshold to stabilize the recomposed household.

strongest_changes: The surrounding join/sever mirror revises familial ṣalaḥ toward maintained or repaired bonds without eliminating the individual-righteousness reading.
The garden, one-water, same-origin growth, and measured-womb sequence activates the household as differentiated living kinship rather than an appended entourage.
Successive guarding, all-gate angelic entry, and peace transform a defensive perimeter into intimate welcome, while the later flowing garden makes permanence dynamic rather than static.
summary.what_was_special: The focus combines a concealed garden, doubled entry, three directions of kinship, and total gates. Context repeatedly turns those details into mechanisms of joining, differentiated growth, preservation, and welcome; the crown-perimeter and angelic-cohesion branches remain contained but live surprises.
remaining_uncertainties: The reconciliation branch of ص ل ح may be contextual resonance rather than the direct sense of صَلَحَ.
Continuity between the 13:11 preservers and the focus angels is reader-supplied; spatial analogy remains viable if agent identity is rejected.
The ecological kinship model may reflect thematic sequencing rather than a causal analogy intended by the text.
The crown-perimeter and angelic-cohesion readings are branch-distant and should remain exploratory alongside the ordinary quantifier and angel senses.
